claim_boundary: Exact installed Desktop 1.40609 main-process source, sliced by unique markers and executed in isolation with synthetic inputs.
Not a capture value proof: the captured schema for these events holds field names only; native source decides key order and values.
The gateway emits only the events listed under executable_events; every other lane event stays a boundary with its native condition.

derivations.resolution: resolveHostBinary().resolution literal: local_override | preseed_in_place | required_version | fallback_version (none suppresses the event)
derivations.resolved_version: `local` when resolution is local_override; otherwise resolveHostBinary().version ?? this.targetVersion (the build-pinned CLI version)

executable_events.condition: getBinaryPathIfReadyWithIdentity() ran and resolveHostBinary().resolution !== `none`; the CCD binary preflight calls it before spawning the CLI for a session start
executable_events.lifecycle_position: session start: before the CLI spawn, therefore before desktop_ccd_session_initialized of that session; also on idle warm/resume spawns (not modeled by the gateway)
executable_events.emulated_state: pinned CLI (bundle code_version) verified on disk at the required version => resolution=required_version, resolved_version=required_version=code_version

boundaries.reason: startTiming marks (preflight_ms, worktree_ms, mcp_ms, query_ms, enqueue_ms, init_ms, first_assistant_ms, ...) are measured spawn-phase durations of the real CLI process; the gateway has no such marks
renderer IPC report (renderer enum, update_count, long_frame_ms_*, hidden_at_emit) is produced by the React transcript view frame timing
emitted after a PTY shell spawn succeeds ({sessionId, shell, spawn_reason}); the gateway spawns no PTY
fires when the warm-lifecycle idle timeout elapses while hasActiveQuery; the gateway only models idle_timeout_started at app quit
requires remoteControlEnabled session state at idle pause time; remote control is not modeled
idle warm (re-spawn) lifecycle is not modeled by the gateway
route/verdict/outcome come from the remote-control auto-enable policy and its RPC result
counts (candidates, renewed, fresh, missing, errors) come from a pass over the on-disk Desktop transcript store the gateway does not hold
trust_total_ms measures a real workspace trust lookup (performance.now)
config_read_ms/config_parse_ms/config_rpc_ms measure the real config file re-read
renderer session-list load timing (attempt_id, duration_ms, session_count, store_state) from the UI store
elevation_type comes from the native module getWindowsElevationType(); no Go token probe was added within the lane time box
transport depends on the Chrome extension bridge configuration (bridgeConfig) which is not pinned
status/unsupported_code depend on host secure-VM support evaluation
internal_server_count and duration_ms come from the real MCP server setup pass
require NotificationService state (initialized, viewing session, banner level) and real OS notifications
